inner.title: never claim superintelligence
inner.body: search your site for "superintelligent" and delete any line that claims it. as of october 2026, nobody has built superintelligence, including you.

inner.title: check forecasts, not headlines
inner.body: check the metaculus forecasts once a quarter instead of reacting to headlines. forecasters still put the first general ai in 2031.

inner.title: score every hype claim
inner.body: ask what was measured, by whom, at what reliability and when. even metr's ai time-horizon numbers needed a correction in may 2026.

inner.title: write what summaries can't
inner.body: publish your own data, build logs and mistakes instead of generic explainers. google search referrals to news publishers fell 40.2% in a year.

inner.title: track the dark traffic
inner.body: measure where visitors really come from, including ai assistants and links shared in private chats. dark social grew from 7.1% to 11.3% of publisher pageviews.
